info.name: Oracle Database MultiCloud Data Plane Integration Multi Cloud Resource Discovery API
Lists all Multicloud Resource Discovery resources based on the specified filters.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return Oracle DB Multicloud Discovery resources that match the specified display name.

params.name: multiCloudResourceDiscoveryId
params.description: The [OCID](/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the Multicloud Discovery resource.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the specified lifecycle state. The state value is case-insensitive.

params.name: oracleDbAzureConnectorId
params.description: A filter to return Oracle DB Azure Azure Identity Connector resources.

params.name: resourcesFilter
params.description: Specifies the type(s) of resources to discover in the target cloud provider.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page token representing the page at which to start retrieving results. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending. If no value is specified, default is timeCreated.

items.docs: Lists all Multicloud Resource Discovery resources based on the specified filters.
